messages:
lena: Heads up — seeing raft leader sync slowdowns in eu-north1, apiserver 502/503s and a few controller-manager restarts. Looks correlated with a DNS/egress spike from the NAT gateway and elevated NVMe iowait on etcd nodes.
raj: On it. Any recent infra changes in eu-north1? NAT autoscaler or a config push?
maya: No config pushes. I pulled metrics — etcd peer RTTs jumped ~3s for a few minutes around 09:14 UTC. NVMe iowait spiked on etcd-a and etcd-b. Controller-manager OOMKill seen twice.
sre-bot: :rotating_light: alert: etcd_high_peer_rtt (eu-north1) fired — 3 instances.
raj: Can someone grab the NAT LB logs and `kubectl get endpoints` for the controlplane svc? Might be egress saturation + packet drops.
lena: NAT LB shows 95% conn usage, many ephemeral ports in TIME_WAIT. Endpoint list looks fine, leader is etcd-a.
tim: Short-term mitigation: 1) throttle GPU onboarding and large attach jobs 2) reduce outbound churn to NAT by deferring non-critical telemetry 3) scale NAT or add another NAT IP (if provider allows).
ops-oncall: Throttling GPU onboarding now — paused nodepool autoscaler for 5m, marking new GPU pools as `onboarding=deferred`. Cordon commands: ```kubectl cordon gpu-onboard-queue-1 && kubectl annotate node gpu-onboard-queue-1 onboarding=deferred```
maya: After cordon, attach pressure dropped and etcd RTT improved to ~200ms. Apiserver 5xxs decreased but still seeing transient controller-manager restarts.
raj: Controller-manager restarts due to leader election delays — leader lock couldn't renew during the peak. We should increase `--leader-elect-retry-period`? Or prefer moving leader to a less contended node.
lena: We should avoid config churn in a burst. Ops — can you scale up the NAT or add an egress IP while we investigate longer-term fixes?
ops-oncall: Requested additional NAT IPs from cloud provider (ticket #CP-4129). Provision ETA ~20m. Meanwhile bumped conntrack table size on proxies: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144`.
sre-bot: :white_check_mark: conntrack size updated on proxies in eu-north1.
tim: Long term action items: 1) move etcd to disks with IO headroom (lower noisy-neighbor risk) 2) add dedicated egress for controlplane to avoid bursting with user egress 3) limit telemetry burstiness during scale events 4) consider making etcd replicas preferentially use NVMe local with IO QoS.
maya: Recording perf graphs and exporting for PM/infra review. Also creating repro steps for the attach spike so we can test mitigations in staging.
lena: Cost tradeoff note — adding reserved NAT IPs and faster disks increases monthly bill. We need a cost estimate before finalizing. Tim/ops, please include delta in CP-4129.
raj: Will open a postmortem draft and link CP-4129 + the rollout notes for the throttling change. Adding follow-ups: run a chaos test simulating ephemeral port exhaustion and NVMe iowait.
lena: Great. For now leave GPU onboarding deferred until provider IPs are up. Keep monitoring apiserver and etcd leader RTT. Thanks all. :pray:
